$schema: Act I radio news bulletins (S1 data). Broadcast from the Varli Prasarayan Tower 'Mother Tower'. Played at chapter transitions once the S3 radio integration lands; each bulletin is a queue of VO line ids consumable by the ./vo/ system.

bulletins.headline: Body found at a Backbay reclamation site

lines.textOriginal: Traffic update. Backbay Road half closed — police activity near the reclamation site.
lines.textTranslation: Traffic update. Backbay Road is half closed — police activity near the reclamation site.

lines.textOriginal: Avoid the sea face if you can. And no — it is not a film shoot.
lines.textTranslation: Avoid the sea face if you can. And no — it is not a film shoot.

bulletins.tone: DJ forced-cheerful, reading a news insert he doesn't want to read
bulletins.headline: Missing watchman found in the creek

lines.textOriginal: Ek chhota sa news, sun lo aur bhool jao — Retibandar creek mein ek watchman mila.
lines.textTranslation: One small news item, hear it and forget it — a watchman was found in the Retibandar creek.

lines.textOriginal: Police keh rahi hai drowning. Watchman ke pocket mein phone nahi tha. Ab gaana suno.
lines.textTranslation: Police say drowning. The watchman's pockets had no phone. Now, some music.

bulletins.headline: Developer consultant Salvi's files go missing

lines.textOriginal: Markets flat, but Fort is not: a consultant's office in the Fort was emptied overnight.
lines.textTranslation: Markets are flat, but the Fort is not: a consultant's Fort office was emptied overnight.

lines.textOriginal: Files, drives, chairs — gone. The builder lobby calls it a routine audit. Routine audits do not need three tempos at midnight.
lines.textTranslation: Files, drives, chairs — gone. The builder lobby calls it a routine audit. Routine audits don't need three tempos at midnight.

bulletins.tone: community radio, close to the mic, sea sounds behind
bulletins.headline: Koliwada mast picks up interference from the Mother Tower

lines.textOriginal: Sorry listeners — mera signal aaj ajeeb hai. Varli tower se ek nayi frequency aa rahi hai.
lines.textTranslation: Sorry listeners — my signal is strange today. A new frequency is coming from the Varli tower.

lines.textOriginal: Koi test nahi hai. Koi license nahi hai. Kaun chala raha hai, koi nahi batata.
lines.textTranslation: There is no test. There is no licence. Nobody says who is running it.

bulletins.tone: late-night, low voice, first broadcast of the new station
bulletins.headline: Bambai After Dark signs on, unlicensed

lines.textOriginal: Agar ye station mila hai toh tum special ho. Ya lucky. Ya dono.
lines.textTranslation: If you found this station, you're special. Or lucky. Or both.

lines.textOriginal: Main wahi baat karunga jo baaki stations nahi kar rahe. Aaj: ek body, ek file, aur ek gaayab aadmi.
lines.textTranslation: I'll talk about what the other stations won't. Tonight: one body, one file, and one missing man.
